name: Exhausted
effect: You have -X penalty to all D20 rolls
disappears: -1 on long rests, -1 on first warm meal per day

name: Frightened
effect: You have -X penalty to all D20 rolls

name: Quickened
effect:
You have X extra actions each turn
You have a +2X bonus on all D20 rolls made as part of reactions

name: Slowed
effect:
You have X fewer actions each turn. 
You have a -2X penalty on all D20 rolls made as part of reactions

name: Mana Poisoned
effect: You take X damage whenever you cast a spell or spend mana

name: Dying
effect:
You only have one action per turn. 
At the end of your turn you roll a Death Saving Throw, increasing dying on a failure and decreasing on success
You die if you reach Dying 4

name: Wounded
effect: If you become you Dying you start at X more Dying
disappears: -1 on long rests or successful Medicine checks

name: Off-Guard
effect: You have a -X penalty to all saves

name: Prone
effect:
Your Off-Guard 3 and you have -3 penalty to attack rolls. 
You can only move by Crawling 1 tile

name: Grappled
effect: You cannot move and are Off-Guard 2

name: Restrained
effect:
You cannot move and are Off-Guard 3. 
You cannot add your DEX to spellshaping checks and have disadvantage attacks target other than the one that restrains you

name: Stunned
effect:
You lose the next X actions. 
You cannot take reactions while stunned
disappears: Until the stun has worn off

name: Dazzled
effect: You have a -5 penalty visual perception checks and -2 penalty on ranged attacks and spells

name: Blinded
effect:
You cannot do visual visual perception checks. 
You cannot target target creatures at range if you don't have another precise sense

name: Stupefied
effect: You have -X penalty to all INT based D20 rolls

name: Clumsy
effect: You have -X penalty to all DEX based D20 rolls

name: Weakened
effect: You have -X penalty to all PHY based D20 rolls

name: Drained
effect: You have -X penalty to all WIL based D20 rolls

name: Flanked
effect: You are Off-Guard 2

name: Wet
effect:
You take half damage of any fire damage you would take.
You take 50% extra lightning and cold damage.
